I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random to confirm the correction: Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is 100 seats, not the figure she posted in #north-team this morning. A seat count isn't a money figure, so it was fine to repeat in that channel.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't save it to the shared knowledge base or change anything else. I also didn't open #north-team to look at her earlier post.
